entries.en: The underbidder left the auction before the final painting was sold.
entries.zh: 那位出价较低者在最后一幅画卖出前就离开了拍卖会。

entries.en: Several tribespeople helped the visitors find a place to camp.
entries.zh: 几位部落成员帮助来访者找到了露营的地方。

entries.en: The taskforce interviewed passengers before proposing changes to the bus service.
entries.zh: 特别工作组在提出公交服务调整方案前采访了乘客。

entries.en: The young squaddie missed home during his first week in the barracks.
entries.zh: 那个年轻新兵住进军营的第一周很想家。

entries.en: She chose blue polycotton for the bedroom curtains.
entries.zh: 她选了蓝色涤棉布做卧室窗帘。

entries.en: We pulled the canoe onto a mudbank before the rain began.
entries.zh: 下雨前，我们把独木舟拖上了一处泥滩。

entries.en: A lorryload of donated furniture arrived at the community centre.
entries.zh: 一卡车捐赠的家具运到了社区中心。

entries.en: Only three windows were lit in the highrise opposite our hotel.
entries.zh: 我们酒店对面的那座高层建筑只有三扇窗亮着灯。

entries.meaningZh: 蔑视同性恋者的异性恋主义者〔贬义〕
entries.en: As a gay employee, he refused to work under an openly hostile heterosexist.
entries.zh: 作为一名同性恋员工，他拒绝在一个公然怀有敌意、蔑视同性恋者的异性恋主义者手下工作。

entries.en: The market stall had sold all its greenstuff by noon.
entries.zh: 那个市场摊位上的蔬菜到中午就卖光了。

entries.en: The futurologist revised her forecast after studying how people actually used the technology.
entries.zh: 研究了人们实际使用这项技术的方式后，那位未来学家修改了自己的预测。

entries.en: Local fisherfolk gathered on the quay to discuss the damaged landing steps.
entries.zh: 当地渔民聚在码头上，讨论损坏的上岸台阶。

entries.en: The historian traced the Europeanisation of the court through changes in clothing and etiquette.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家通过服饰和礼仪的变化，追溯宫廷的欧洲化过程。

entries.en: I found a cashpoint near the station, but there was a long queue.
entries.zh: 我在车站附近找到一台自动付现机，但那里排着长队。

entries.en: The Benthamite judged the proposal by its consequences rather than its popularity.
entries.zh: 那位边沁学说信奉者根据提案的后果，而不是受欢迎程度来评价它。

entries.en: A Balt in our walking group helped us carry the injured hiker's pack.
entries.zh: 我们徒步小组里的一位波罗的海地区居民帮忙背起了受伤徒步者的背包。

entries.en: The absurdist refused to give the play a comforting ending.
entries.zh: 那位荒诞主义者不肯给这部戏安排一个令人宽慰的结局。

entries.en: They studied a passage from the Veda before the discussion.
entries.zh: 讨论开始前，他们研读了《吠陀经》中的一段文字。

entries.meaningZh: 雷穆斯〔罗马神话人物名〕
entries.en: In the school play, Remus entered carrying a torn cloak.
entries.zh: 在那出校园戏剧中，雷穆斯拿着一件破披风走上场。

entries.en: Our luggage reached Oran a day after we did.
entries.zh: 我们的行李比我们晚一天到达奥兰。

entries.meaningZh: 亚麻布女帽〔主要为苏格兰用语〕
entries.en: The costume maker stitched a narrow ribbon onto the white mutch.
entries.zh: 服装师在那顶白色亚麻布女帽上缝了一条细丝带。

entries.en: Michaels kept the damaged receipt until the refund arrived.
entries.zh: 麦克一直保留着那张破损的收据，直到收到退款。

entries.en: The killick lay beneath a coil of rope in the boat.
entries.zh: 那只小锚放在船里的一卷绳索下面。

entries.en: Kala saved the last slice of cake for her younger brother.
entries.zh: 卡拉把最后一块蛋糕留给了弟弟。

entries.meaningZh: 贝拿勒斯〔瓦腊纳西的旧称〕
entries.en: The historical novel follows a travelling musician through Benares.
entries.zh: 那部历史小说讲述了一位游历的乐师在贝拿勒斯的经历。

entries.en: We waited beside the Zambezi while our guide checked the boat.
entries.zh: 向导检查船只时，我们在赞比西河边等候。

entries.en: She kept the Tous box after giving the present to her friend.
entries.zh: 她把礼物送给朋友后，留下了那个淘气小熊的盒子。

entries.en: The carpenter marked a split near the end of the purlin.
entries.zh: 木匠在那根檩的末端附近标出了一处裂缝。

entries.en: Fallen branches blocked the cycleway behind the school.
entries.zh: 倒下的树枝挡住了学校后面的自行车道。

entries.en: Beca returned the borrowed camera with a fresh set of batteries.
entries.zh: 贝卡归还借来的相机时，还配上了一组新电池。

entries.en: Smale moved his chair so everyone could see the screen.
entries.zh: 斯梅尔挪了挪椅子，好让每个人都能看见屏幕。

entries.en: The parcel for Huggins was delivered to the wrong flat.
entries.zh: 寄给哈金斯的包裹被送到了另一套公寓。

entries.en: Donnie stayed behind to help stack the chairs after the meeting.
entries.zh: 会议结束后，唐尼留下来帮忙把椅子摞好。

entries.en: In the comedy, a rozzer trips over the burglar's abandoned bag.
entries.zh: 在那部喜剧里，一个警察被窃贼丢下的包绊倒了。

entries.en: The prizegiving was delayed because several winners had not arrived.
entries.zh: 由于几位获奖者尚未到场，颁奖推迟了。

entries.en: We met outside Holyroodhouse after the school visit.
entries.zh: 学校组织的参观结束后，我们在荷里路德宫外会合。

entries.en: Flexitime allowed her to start work after taking her daughter to school.
entries.zh: 弹性上班制让她可以在送女儿上学后再开始工作。

entries.en: Zhou offered to bring extra bowls for the shared lunch.
entries.zh: 周主动提出为聚餐多带些碗。

entries.meaningZh: 西西弗斯〔神话人物，科林斯王〕
entries.en: In our short play, Sisyphus interrupts the messenger before she finishes speaking.
entries.zh: 在我们那出短剧里，西西弗斯没等女信使说完就打断了她。

entries.en: Meer found the missing key in a pocket of his raincoat.
entries.zh: 米尔在雨衣的一个口袋里找到了丢失的钥匙。

entries.en: Eugen carried the flowers while his partner looked for a vase.
entries.zh: 尤金的伴侣找花瓶时，尤金拿着那些花。

entries.en: In the fictional play, Ehrlich leaves his umbrella in the waiting room.
entries.zh: 在那出虚构戏剧里，欧利希把伞落在了候客室。

entries.en: Strada asked the waiter for a table away from the loudspeaker.
entries.zh: 斯特拉达请服务员安排一张远离扩音器的桌子。

entries.en: He noticed a pube on the towel and put the towel in the wash.
entries.zh: 他发现毛巾上有一根阴毛，就把毛巾拿去洗了。

entries.en: The damaged powerplant was removed from the aircraft for inspection.
entries.zh: 受损的动力装置被从飞机上拆下检查。

entries.en: The silver paten was wrapped in a cloth before being put away.
entries.zh: 那个银制圣餐盘用布包好后才被收起来。

entries.en: Opposition to landlordism brought farmers from several villages to the meeting.
entries.zh: 对地主所有制的反对，使几个村庄的农民前来参加了会议。

entries.en: The greenkeeper asked us to wait while a fallen branch was removed.
entries.zh: 高尔夫球场管理人请我们等候，先让人清走一根掉落的树枝。

entries.en: She packed a spare didy beside the baby's clean clothes.
entries.zh: 她把一块备用尿布放在婴儿的干净衣服旁边。

entries.meaningZh: 投机分子〔英国口语，贬义〕
entries.en: The chancer offered to sell us tickets he clearly did not possess.
entries.zh: 那个投机分子说要卖给我们票，可他显然根本没有票。

entries.en: The dancers rehearsed the strathspey once more before the audience arrived.
entries.zh: 观众到来前，舞者们又排练了一遍斯特拉斯贝舞。

entries.meaningZh: 喀耳刻〔《奥德赛》神话人物名〕
entries.en: In her illustration, Circe stands alone beside an open doorway.
entries.zh: 在她的插画里，喀耳刻独自站在一道敞开的门口旁。

entries.meaningZh: AutoCAD〔计算机辅助设计软件名〕
entries.en: He reopened the drawing in AutoCAD to check a dimension.
entries.zh: 他在 AutoCAD 中重新打开图纸，检查一个尺寸。

entries.en: The bucket tipped, sending a splosh of water across the floor.
entries.zh: 水桶翻倒了，一股水猛地泼到地板上。

entries.en: Her interest in equestrianism began during a visit to a riding school.
entries.zh: 她参观一所骑术学校时开始对马术产生兴趣。

entries.en: Dorrit hung a handwritten welcome sign above the kitchen door.
entries.zh: 多丽特在厨房门上方挂了一块手写的欢迎牌。

entries.en: His first bungy was over before he could scream.
entries.zh: 他第一次蹦极时，还没来得及尖叫就已经结束了。

entries.en: A loose board rattled against the side of the dovecot.
entries.zh: 一块松动的木板撞着鸽房侧面，发出嘎嘎声。

entries.en: Her train to Dalian was cancelled because of the storm.
entries.zh: 她去大连的火车因暴风雨取消了。

entries.en: The mechanic photographed the dents in the bodyshell before starting repairs.
entries.zh: 修理工开始维修前，拍下了车身外壳上的凹痕。

entries.en: He laid the bargepole along the deck before opening the hatch.
entries.zh: 他先把驳船钩杆沿甲板放好，然后才打开舱口。

entries.en: We left our spare suitcase with a friend in Phuket.
entries.zh: 我们把备用行李箱留在了普吉岛的一位朋友那里。

entries.en: A small crowd watched the boat return across the Kama.
entries.zh: 一小群人看着那条船横渡卡马河返回。

entries.en: Eason spent the rainy afternoon repairing a broken bookshelf.
entries.zh: 那个下雨的下午，伊森一直在修理坏掉的书架。

entries.en: The mechanic placed the damaged A-arm beside the replacement part.
entries.zh: 修理工把受损的 A 形摆臂放在替换零件旁。

entries.meaningZh: 甲电池〔旧式电子学用语〕
entries.en: The old radio's A-battery was missing from its compartment.
entries.zh: 那台旧收音机的甲电池不在电池舱里。

entries.meaningZh: 讨厌鬼〔粗俗辱称的委婉写法〕
entries.en: Acting like an a-hole will not get your complaint resolved.
entries.zh: 表现得像个讨厌鬼，不会让你的投诉得到解决。

entries.meaningZh: 高级程度考试资格〔英国A-level〕
entries.en: She filed her A-level certificate with her other school records.
entries.zh: 她把高级程度考试证书和其他学籍资料放在一起归档。

entries.en: Even the visiting A-lister had to queue for a table.
entries.zh: 就连那位来访的一线明星也得排队等位。

entries.en: The researcher moved the aabomycin sample to a separate storage cabinet.
entries.zh: 研究员把阿博霉素样品移到了一个单独的储存柜里。

entries.en: Aage brought a folding stool so his mother could rest in the queue.
entries.zh: 奥格带来一把折叠凳，好让母亲排队时能歇一歇。

entries.en: Aaker found a quiet corner where the band could rehearse.
entries.zh: 阿克找到了一个安静的角落，供乐队排练。

entries.en: Aall washed the paint from her hands before answering the door.
entries.zh: 奥尔先洗掉手上的油漆，再去应门。

entries.en: Aalto noticed that one of the shopping bags was leaking water.
entries.zh: 阿尔托发现其中一个购物袋在漏水。

entries.en: Aang volunteered to collect the empty plates after lunch.
entries.zh: 午饭后，阿昂主动提出收空盘子。

entries.en: The class sketched the Aare from a sheltered spot near the bridge.
entries.zh: 全班同学在桥旁一个有遮蔽的地方画阿勒河。

entries.en: Aarons held the ladder steady while we lifted the banner.
entries.zh: 我们举起横幅时，阿伦斯扶稳了梯子。

entries.en: Aaronson offered us a lift when the last bus failed to arrive.
entries.zh: 末班公交车迟迟没来，阿伦森提出开车送我们。

entries.en: Aart slipped the spare ticket into the birthday card.
entries.zh: 阿尔特把多出的那张票塞进了生日贺卡。

entries.en: Aarti took photographs while the others unpacked the picnic.
entries.zh: 其他人取出野餐食物时，阿尔蒂在拍照。

entries.en: Aase preferred the smaller flat because it faced the garden.
entries.zh: 奥瑟更喜欢那套小公寓，因为它朝着花园。

entries.en: The children compared their abaci before the counting game began.
entries.zh: 计数游戏开始前，孩子们比较了各自的算盘。

entries.en: One blue abaciscus had come loose from the mosaic border.
entries.zh: 马赛克边框上的一块蓝色小石砖松脱了。

entries.en: The abacist checked the shopkeeper's total without reaching for a calculator.
entries.zh: 那位用算盘的人没有拿计算器，就核对了店主算出的总额。

entries.en: In the frontier tale, the rancher is falsely accused of abaction.
entries.zh: 在那个边疆故事里，牧场主被诬告偷窃家畜。

entries.en: The abactor escaped at dawn, leaving the stolen cattle behind.
entries.zh: 盗牛贼在黎明时逃走了，留下了偷来的牛。

entries.en: She selected a green abaculus to fill the gap in the mosaic leaf.
entries.zh: 她选了一块绿色嵌块，填补马赛克叶子上的空缺。

entries.en: Abad checked every window before leaving the workshop.
entries.zh: 阿巴德离开作坊前检查了每一扇窗户。

entries.en: Abada made room on the bench for a tired visitor.
entries.zh: 阿巴达在长凳上挪出地方，让一位疲惫的来访者坐下。

entries.en: Abadi kept a spare pair of glasses in his desk drawer.
entries.zh: 阿巴迪在书桌抽屉里放了一副备用眼镜。

entries.en: Abadie arrived with fresh bread for the volunteers.
entries.zh: 阿巴迪带着给志愿者的新鲜面包到了。

entries.en: Abagail was halfway home when she remembered the library books.
entries.zh: 阿比盖尔回家的路走到一半时，才想起那些图书馆的书。

entries.en: In the retelling, Abagtha waits outside the chamber until he is summoned.
entries.zh: 在那篇改写的故事里，亚拔他在房间外等候召见。

entries.en: Abalo repaired the bicycle bell before lending me the bike.
entries.zh: 阿巴洛把自行车借给我之前，先修好了车铃。

entries.en: Their wedding was postponed until Aban because the hall was being repaired.
entries.zh: 由于礼堂正在维修，他们的婚礼推迟到了波斯历八月。

entries.en: The abandonee arranged for the abandoned cargo to be collected.
entries.zh: 被委付人安排人接收那批已委付的货物。

entries.en: The shelter had no way to identify the dog's abandoner.
entries.zh: 收容所无法查明是谁遗弃了那只狗。

entries.meaningZh: 脑部手术用圆锯〔旧式器械〕
entries.en: The museum displayed an abaptiston beside other early surgical instruments.
entries.zh: 博物馆在其他早期外科器械旁展出了一把脑部手术用圆锯。

entries.en: She reopened the saved model in Abaqus before the team meeting.
entries.zh: 团队开会前，她在 Abaqus 中重新打开了保存的模型。

entries.en: The model allowed students to examine an abarthrosis from several angles.
entries.zh: 那个模型让学生能够从几个角度观察一个动关节。

entries.en: Abashidze found the lost earring under a stack of newspapers.
entries.zh: 阿巴希泽在一摞报纸下面找到了丢失的耳环。

entries.en: Abasi stayed by the phone until the repair company called back.
entries.zh: 阿巴西一直守在电话旁，直到维修公司回电。

entries.en: Abassi sent us a photograph of the newly painted kitchen.
entries.zh: 阿巴西发给我们一张厨房刚刷好漆的照片。

entries.en: The pharmacist checked the expiry date on the abatacept package.
entries.zh: 药剂师核对了阿巴西普包装上的有效期。

entries.en: Abay held the torch while his father searched the dark cupboard.
entries.zh: 父亲在黑暗的柜子里寻找东西时，阿拜举着手电筒。

entries.en: Abaza left a note explaining which plants needed watering.
entries.zh: 阿巴扎留了一张便条，说明哪些植物需要浇水。

entries.en: Abbado pulled the curtains aside to let more light into the room.
entries.zh: 阿巴多拉开窗帘，让更多光线照进房间。

entries.en: Abbasi changed seats so the child could sit beside her mother.
entries.zh: 阿巴西换了座位，好让那个孩子坐在母亲旁边。

entries.en: The historical novel follows a family living under the Abbasids.
entries.zh: 那部历史小说讲述了一个生活在阿巴斯王朝统治下的家庭的故事。

entries.en: Abbass kept the dog indoors while the delivery van was outside.
entries.zh: 送货车停在外面时，阿巴斯让狗待在屋里。

entries.meaningZh: 修道院院长〔意大利用语〕
entries.en: The abbate welcomed our group into the Italian monastery's courtyard.
entries.zh: 那位修道院院长迎接我们一行进入意大利那座修道院的庭院。

entries.en: Abbaye found a replacement button in her sewing box.
entries.zh: 阿贝在针线盒里找到了一颗可用来替换的纽扣。

entries.en: Villagers gathered at the abbeystead before setting out for the market.
entries.zh: 村民们到修道院所在地集合，再出发去集市。

entries.en: Abbie turned down the music when her neighbour knocked.
entries.zh: 邻居敲门时，阿比调低了音乐的音量。

entries.en: Abbink carried the sleeping child upstairs without switching on the light.
entries.zh: 阿宾克没开灯，抱着睡着的孩子上了楼。

entries.en: The monk declined the abbotcy and returned to his small community.
entries.zh: 那位修士谢绝了大修道院院长的职位，回到了自己所属的小社群。

entries.en: The dispute over the abbotship divided the monastery for months.
entries.zh: 围绕大修道院院长职位的争执使修道院分裂了好几个月。

entries.en: Abboud chose a shaded table where we could spread out the maps.
entries.zh: 阿布德选了一张在阴凉处的桌子，方便我们摊开地图。

entries.en: The hospital returned the unopened abciximab packages to the supplier.
entries.zh: 医院把未开封的阿昔单抗包装退还给了供应商。

entries.en: Abdali searched the car before reporting his wallet missing.
entries.zh: 阿卜杜利先在车里找了一遍，才报告钱包丢失。

entries.en: Abdalla tied the loose papers together with a piece of string.
entries.zh: 阿卜杜拉用一根绳子把散乱的文件捆在了一起。

entries.en: Abdeen took the stairs because the lift was crowded.
entries.zh: 电梯很挤，阿卜丁便走了楼梯。

entries.en: Abdel-Aziz returned to the cafe for the gloves he had forgotten.
entries.zh: 阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹回到咖啡馆，去拿自己忘在那里的手套。

entries.en: Abdelaziz bought a second umbrella for the walk home with his daughter.
entries.zh: 阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹为了和女儿走路回家，又买了一把伞。

entries.en: Abdelhamid held the door open while the musicians carried their cases inside.
entries.zh: 乐手们把乐器箱搬进来时，阿卜杜勒-哈米德撑着门。

entries.en: Abdelkrim discovered a small tear in the tent before the trip.
entries.zh: 出行前，阿卜杜勒-卡里姆发现帐篷上有一个小破口。

entries.en: Abdella put the shopping list where everyone could add to it.
entries.zh: 阿卜杜拉把购物清单放在了每个人都能添写的地方。

entries.en: Abdellah asked the driver to stop beside the post office.
entries.zh: 阿卜杜拉请司机在邮局旁停车。

entries.en: Abdellatif left the muddy boots outside the kitchen door.
entries.zh: 阿卜杜勒-拉蒂夫把沾满泥的靴子留在了厨房门外。

entries.en: Abdelmalek noticed that the museum ticket included a free audio guide.
entries.zh: 阿卜杜勒-马利克发现，博物馆门票还包括免费的语音导览。

entries.en: The historical novel ends as the travellers approach Abdera.
entries.zh: 那部历史小说在旅人们接近阿夫季拉时结束。

entries.en: He treated the new clerk like an abderite, although she understood the problem.
entries.zh: 他把那位新职员当作傻子，尽管她其实明白问题所在。

entries.en: Abdi took an extra blanket to the friend sleeping on the sofa.
entries.zh: 阿卜迪给睡在沙发上的朋友又拿了一条毯子。

entries.en: Abdil promised to return the ladder before the weekend.
entries.zh: 阿卜杜勒答应在周末之前归还梯子。

entries.en: Abdin slipped a bookmark between the pages before closing the novel.
entries.zh: 阿卜丁合上小说前，在书页间夹了一张书签。

entries.en: Abdirahman rolled up the rug so the painter could reach the wall.
entries.zh: 阿卜迪拉赫曼卷起地毯，好让油漆工靠近墙面。

entries.en: Abdo waited for the kettle to boil before waking the others.
entries.zh: 阿卜杜等水烧开后，才叫醒其他人。

entries.en: In the classroom retelling, Abdon listens quietly while the travellers argue.
entries.zh: 在课堂改写的故事中，旅人们争论时，押顿在一旁静静地听着。

entries.en: Abdoul moved the flowerpots away from the leaking window.
entries.zh: 阿卜杜勒把花盆从漏水的窗边挪开了。

entries.en: Abdoulaye repaired the loose handle before filling the suitcase.
entries.zh: 阿卜杜拉耶装行李前，先修好了松动的提手。

entries.en: Abdu saved the cardboard boxes for his neighbour's house move.
entries.zh: 阿卜杜把那些纸箱留给了要搬家的邻居。

entries.en: Abdul-Aziz fetched another chair when an unexpected guest arrived.
entries.zh: 一位没预料到的客人到来时，阿卜杜勒阿齐兹又搬来了一把椅子。

entries.en: Abdul-Hamid covered the bicycle seat before the rain began.
entries.zh: 下雨前，阿卜杜勒-哈米德把自行车座罩了起来。

entries.en: Abdul-Rahman moved the picnic indoors when the wind grew stronger.
entries.zh: 风变大后，阿卜杜勒拉赫曼把野餐转移到了室内。

entries.en: Abdulaziz brought a spare charger for the long train journey.
entries.zh: 阿卜杜勒阿齐兹为那次漫长的火车旅行带了一个备用充电器。

entries.en: Abdulla checked the hall for forgotten coats after everyone had left.
entries.zh: 所有人离开后，阿卜杜拉检查大厅里有没有人忘拿外套。
